# Reading/ Loading

* CSV : pd.read_csv(<file_name>)
* Excel : pd.read_excel(<file_name>)
* JSON : pd.read_json(<file_name>)
* HTML_tables : pd.read_csv_html(<file_name>)
* SQL : pd.read_sql("SELECT.....", connection)
* URL : pd.read_<anyone> ('url')

<anyone> means excel/json/html/sql
<is_just_a_place_holder>, remove <> with path name
